The alternatives fill one slot, never add marks. A guessed decision/root or vertex location alone is insufficient. A vertex value/location alone earns no R1: the interior extremum is on the far side from zero and does not prove constant sign.
official_qualifiers.R2: B1 correct cubic primitive from the supplied quadratic velocity.
official_qualifiers.R3: DM1 dependent on R1: from an attempted primitive evaluate both bounds of each chosen leg and sum nonnegative lengths. One or two legs; limited FT from their credible solved root and interval decision. Calculator quadrature values alone do not earn this mark.
official_qualifiers.R4: A1 canonical distance exact or 3sf, dependent on R2 and R3 and correct working (www); no ordinary own-root FT. A one-slip false interior root in a no-change case loses R4 even if the total coincides, giving 3/4 with R1/R2/R3. OD-6 genuine unchanged-difficulty datum misreads instead follow the shared A/B FT rule. Apply gross dependencies before a net MR deduction; an eligible R2 deduction does not remove R4.
